languageHelp: Choose the language used throughout the application.

backgroundJobs.title: Background Jobs
backgroundJobs.help: Work the server processes in the background for you. Click a failed count to see what went wrong.
backgroundJobs.notTracked: This job doesn't keep track of this count, so it is always shown as 0.

metadata-fetch.name: Metadata fetch
metadata-fetch.description: Looks up song metadata from the configured sources.

song-history.name: Song history
song-history.description: Records the changes made to your songs. Failed entries are no longer retried.

song-history-baseline.name: Song history baseline
song-history-baseline.description: Records the original state of songs added before song history kept one.

song-history-play-count-cleanup.name: Song history play count cleanup
song-history-play-count-cleanup.description: Removes old history entries that only recorded plays. Starts once the song history baseline is complete.

wishlist.name: Wishlist check
wishlist.description: Periodically checks your wishlist searches for new results.

bitrate-backfill.name: Bitrate backfill
bitrate-backfill.description: Reads the bitrate of songs that are missing it.

metadata-cleanup.name: Metadata cleanup
metadata-cleanup.description: Expires and removes old fetched metadata.

staging-cleanup.name: Sync staging cleanup
staging-cleanup.description: Removes leftover temporary files from finished device syncs.
